name: Library Layouts
author: Aseoriy
description: Re-lays out the whole launcher like other popular game clients: a menu bar and top tabs, a game list on the left, a cover-art home page and a hero game page. Starts with a Steam-style layout. Everything it does can be tuned in its settings.

settings.label: Layout
settings.description: Steam-style rearranges the whole launcher. Off puts Sail back exactly as it was.

settings.label: Action buttons
settings.description: Settings, Plugins, Big Picture, Add a Game and the rest. The menu bar always has them too.

options.label: In the menu bar, like Steam
Where Sail's own settings put them

settings.label: Page names
settings.description: Steam's names for the pages (Store, Community) or Sail's own (Game Downloads, Mods).

settings.label: Downloads tab
settings.description: Steam has no Downloads tab; the bottom bar opens it. Turn this on to also show it with the other tabs.

settings.label: Steam colours
settings.description: Steam's slate greys and blue instead of your Sail theme.

settings.label: Tall covers
settings.description: Poster art on the home page when a game has it.

settings.label: Recent games shelf
settings.description: A row of the games you played last above your library.

settings.label: Bottom bar
settings.description: Add a Game, Downloads and Friends & Chat along the bottom.

settings.label: Friends panel
settings.description: Show the friends list on the right.
